categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a system integrator and IT service provider, offering computer systems (servers, workstations, PCs), computer peripherals, network products, data storage systems, software development, cybersecurity products and services, consulting, maintenance, and communication engineering. It serves industries including manufacturing, telecommunications, financial services, government, education, healthcare, and retail. Key business areas include AI system architecture planning, cloud integration services, threat detection and response (MDR), and outsourced cybersecurity management (MSSP).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor processing technologies, GPU computing for AI and deep learning, cloud computing, containerization (Docker/Microservices), AI/GenAI, IoT, 5G, and edge computing. It develops and integrates multi-modal AI application frameworks, zero-trust security platforms based on NIST standards, AI-driven cybersecurity defense systems, and high-speed optical transmission networks (P-OTN) for AI compute reliability. The company also focuses on software-defined networking (SDN), network function virtualization (NFV), and intent-based networking (IBN) for network automation and security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 6,000 customers, including half of Taiwan's top 1,000 enterprises and more than 600 listed companies. Its primary markets span manufacturing, telecommunications, financial services, government agencies, education and research institutions, healthcare providers, and retail/e-commerce sectors. It targets large enterprises requiring integrated IT infrastructure, AI applications, cybersecurity, cloud services, and digital transformation solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are predominantly domestic in Taiwan, accounting for approximately 98.47% of sales. It maintains offices across major Taiwanese cities including Hsinchu, Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Chiayi, Tainan, Kaohsiung, and Hualien. It also has overseas subsidiaries and investments in the USA, China (Ningbo and Shanghai), and offshore investment entities in the British Virgin Islands to support North American and Chinese markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT supply chain. It acts as a system integrator and professional service provider, sourcing hardware and software products from upstream manufacturers and delivering integrated solutions, consulting, and maintenance services to downstream enterprise customers. It holds agency and distribution rights for leading global IT brands and adds value through software development and managed services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding AI/GenAI applications, cloud and hybrid cloud services, big data analytics, IoT solutions, 5G network infrastructure, and cybersecurity innovations such as zero-trust architectures and AI-driven threat detection. R&D focuses on multi-modal AI frameworks, AI agent integration with OCR and LLM for automated workflows, P-OTN optical network architectures for AI compute, and development of AI security defense systems. The company also invests in software microservices, containerization, and next-generation data center management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of IT hardware and software, system integration services, consulting, maintenance and repair services, outsourced cybersecurity management (MSSP), and value-added software development. The company also earns from licensing, training services, and long-term service contracts. It emphasizes high-margin professional services and integrated solutions to enhance profitability beyond traditional hardware sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of Taiwan's largest system integrators and IT service providers, holding a leading market position domestically. It competes with other system integrators and IT service firms by leveraging its extensive product portfolio, strong technical expertise, comprehensive service network, and deep industry knowledge. Its competitive advantages include a broad range of global IT brand partnerships, a large skilled workforce with numerous certifications, and a focus on emerging technologies like AI, cloud, and cybersecurity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the most recent fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$7.54 billion, representing a 3.66% increase over the prior year, with net profit of about NT$798 million and earnings per share of NT$7.50. The company has demonstrated steady revenue and profit growth over recent years, supported by a solid financial structure and stable cash flows. Total assets exceeded NT$7.14 billion with equity of NT$3.44 billion, reflecting a healthy balance sheet and ongoing investment in fixed assets and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering comprehensive, integrated IT solutions combining hardware, software, and professional services tailored to diverse industries. It emphasizes rapid delivery ('speed') and skilled talent to meet complex enterprise IT needs. Its value proposition includes advanced AI and cybersecurity capabilities, multi-cloud and hybrid cloud integration, and strong after-sales support through a widespread service network. The company also focuses on innovation in AI, big data, IoT, and zero-trust security to provide cutting-edge, customized solutions that enhance customer operational efficiency and security.
